project.name: SimNow Trading Terminal
project.description: CTP-based futures/options simulation trading terminal with Web and Electron modes, supporting real-time market data, order management, and technical analysis.

nodes.name: Role A Diagnosis Reference
nodes.summary: Startup diagnosis rules for Role A. Defines information source priority (git log > code > task.md > knowledge graph), execution steps including git pull/log/status/branch checks, cross-validation of task.md against git log, dual-window conflict protection, and hard constraints (no code writing or commits during diagnosis).

nodes.name: Role A Merge Reference
nodes.summary: Merge and finalization rules for Role A. Defines PR description template (title, completed content, impact scope, test results, manual verification issues, dependencies, review conclusion), documentation update steps (task.md, task-dev-flow.md, progress.md, dev-record-a.md), knowledge graph evaluation (display only, no auto-update), and manual merge instruction.

nodes.name: Role A Review Reference
nodes.summary: Code review rules for Role A. Defines pre-review preparation (git pull, status check, diff), three-tier severity classification (blocking/improvement/question), review dimensions (correctness, test quality, code quality, scope control, doc sync, risk, task completeness), mandatory file-first-then-conclusion pattern, and review feedback handling flow with targeted fixes requiring corresponding tests.

nodes.name: Role A TDD Reference
nodes.summary: TDD development rules for Role A. Defines red-green-refactor cycle, commit message conventions (test/feat/refactor prefixed with task-xx), documentation sync with dev-record-a.md, and completion criteria including progress.md update and transition to self-verification.

nodes.name: Role A Verification Reference
nodes.summary: Verification rules for Role A covering two phases: self-verification (compare task.md acceptance criteria vs actual code, one item at a time, missing items require user decision) and manual verification (strictly no automated tests, output curl/browser steps one at a time, record to verify-discussion-prX.md after each item, batch commit all verification records at end).

nodes.name: Role B Diagnosis Reference
nodes.summary: Startup diagnosis rules for Role B. Extends Role A diagnosis with task file selection (task.md vs task-redesign.md vs custom path), multi-PR discovery (lists all eligible PRs not just first), redesigned task file strategy (task-redesign.md reads redesign-plan.md), and structured diagnosis result format with table showing all available and blocked PRs.

nodes.name: Role B Merge Reference
nodes.summary: Merge and finalization rules for Role B. Same PR description template as Role A but with task-source-aware documentation updates: task.md requires updating task-dev-flow.md, progress.md, and dev-record-b.md; task-redesign.md only updates itself. Knowledge graph evaluation is display-only.

nodes.name: Role B Review Reference
nodes.summary: Code review rules for Role B. Similar structure to Role A review but with different file naming conventions per task source (review-feedback-b-pr{N}.md for task.md, review-feedback-redesign-{N}.md for task-redesign.md) and different storage locations (docs/dev-records/role-b/ vs docs/snapshots/role-b/).

nodes.name: Role B TDD Reference
nodes.summary: TDD development rules for Role B. Extends Role A TDD with task-source awareness: task-redesign.md requires reading both task-redesign.md and redesign-plan.md, uses different commit conventions (feat(redesign-rX)), and skips dev-record-b.md for redesign tasks.

nodes.name: Role B Verification Reference
nodes.summary: Verification rules for Role B. Covers self-verification with mandatory status update and commit before handoff to review window, and manual verification with task-source-aware record storage (docs/dev-records/role-b/ for task.md, docs/snapshots/role-b/ for task-redesign.md). Emphasizes that skipping status update breaks the review window workflow.

nodes.name: Bug Fix Cleanup Reference
nodes.summary: Cleanup and finalization rules for bug fixes. Four-step process: update task2.md (PR status to fixed + commit hash) and progress.md, git diff to show all changes for user confirmation, commit with fix(task-xx) convention, and generate completion report with fix details, test results, and acceptance status.

nodes.name: Bug Fix Diagnosis Reference
nodes.summary: Diagnosis steps for bug fixes. Six-step process: git log check, read task2.md, cross-validate against git log, detect work scope (backend/frontend/both based on file paths), branch validation, and output structured diagnosis result. Includes block report format for dependent PRs.

nodes.name: Bug Fix Root Cause Reference
nodes.summary: Root cause investigation methodology for bug fixes. Five phases: understand problem (read task2.md, affected files), stable reproduction (run tests, manual reproduce), trace data flow through the SimNow stack (frontend -> API -> backend -> CTP -> callback -> WebSocket -> frontend), form hypothesis with evidence, and verify hypothesis with minimal change testing. Stops after 3 failed hypotheses.

nodes.name: Bug Fix TDD Reference
nodes.summary: TDD fix process for bug fixes. Four steps: write failing test (red light confirmed, location depends on scope), implement fix following task2.md exactly, run full test suite (both backend and frontend), and commit with fix(task-xx) convention. Emphasizes no side-effect changes.

nodes.name: Bug Fix Verification Reference
nodes.summary: Verification rules for bug fixes. Two phases: self-verification (check task2.md acceptance criteria line by line, show missing/deferred items to user) and manual verification (backend via Swagger/API, frontend via browser). Work scope determines which side to verify.

nodes.name: CTP Field Alignment Design
nodes.summary: Aligns documentation data models with real CTP API field structures. Decides to remove backend camelCase-to-snake_case conversion layer, passing CTP camelCase fields end-to-end through WebSocket to frontend. Updates design.md, trading-instructions.md, and dev.md with 50+ field mappings across MarketSnapshot, OrderRequest, OrderReturn, TradeReturn, PositionInfo, AccountInfo, and InstrumentInfo.

nodes.name: Modal-Tab Transition Design
nodes.summary: Designs smooth bidirectional conversion between floating popups (OrderPopup/QueryPopup) and docked tabs. Introduces a unified content host model where each content instance stays alive through dock/floating transitions (ECharts, vtable scroll, local state preserved). Adds a floatingWindows store and detach/dock actions.

nodes.name: Popup Free Resize Design
nodes.summary: Extends floating windows (FloatingWindow, QueryPopup, OrderPopup) with 8-direction resize capability (n/s/e/w + four corners). Introduces a unified resizeDrag.ts utility and enhanced ResizeHandle component with direction-based cursors, min size clamping, and Esc/cancel support.

nodes.name: Market Subscription Optimization Design
nodes.summary: Optimizes MarketTable subscription behavior to eliminate subscribe/unsubscribe churn during scrolling. Introduces delayed unsubscription (30s grace period), zero HTTP during drag, LRU eviction with SOFT_LIMIT=480, partial record updates (updateRecords instead of setRecords), and snapshot backfill from backend cache after subscription.

nodes.name: Query Panel and Market Table Redesign
nodes.summary: Simplifies QueryPanel by removing contracts and K-line tabs (5 tabs remain: orders/trades/positions/account/stop-orders). Enhances MarketTable with missing contract fields, fixed column widths, and horizontal scrollbar. Removes ContractQuery.tsx and related dead code.

nodes.name: Bottom Status Bar Redesign
nodes.summary: Moves connection status (MD/TD) and tool buttons from GlobalBar to a new BottomBar component at the application bottom. Removes the overflow menu, flattens FPS/network monitor as direct buttons, adds expand/collapse toggle with animation. Also fixes market table scrollbar positioning bug.

nodes.name: Market Table Fixes Design
nodes.summary: Fixes 5 UI/data consistency issues in MarketPanel/MarketTable: page not filling available space, contract column not frozen, favorites occasionally missing data pushes (3-layer desync in subscription manager), right-click not selecting contract, and dual highlight zones (gold vtable selection vs blue batch selection).

nodes.name: Scrollbar Unified Refactor
nodes.summary: Unifies three scrollbar systems (browser native, vtable, TabBar) into a consistent 'subtle thin bar' style. Uses neutral gray at 35% opacity (60% on hover), 6px width. Aligns vtable scrollbar colors via vtableTheme.ts constants with CSS variable dual-source approach. Hides TabBar scrollbar entirely.

nodes.name: TabBar Overflow and Add Menu Redesign
nodes.summary: Redesigns TabBar: replaces + button direct-open-settings with hover-expand add menu (order/kline/query/settings tabs as docked pages), replaces overflow scrollbar with mouse wheel scrolling + overflow dropdown menu. Includes accessibility (role=menu, aria-expanded), click-outside-close, and keyboard support.

nodes.name: Tab Context Menu and Pinned Market Design
nodes.summary: Extends TabBar with 5-item context menu (close/close others/close all/pin/window) and pins market tab to left as non-scrollable, non-closable, menu-less anchor. Adds pinned boolean to Tab interface, closeOthers/closeAll/togglePin actions, and pinned-first render ordering.

nodes.name: Tray Menu Redesign
nodes.summary: Unifies tray menu with native top menu by introducing shared menuTemplate.ts and menuActions.ts single source of truth. Mirrors full menu structure (market/trading/settings/performance) into tray with submenus. Fixes exit behavior inconsistency (tray destroy vs app.quit). Adds tests for menu template and actions.

nodes.name: Order Empty State and Quantity Step Design
nodes.summary: Removes instrument guard from OrderPage/KLinePage so they render full UI even without selected contract (-- placeholders, search bar with 'select contract' prompt). Implements sticky quantity step: clicking quick volume buttons (1/20/50/100) sets both volume and +/- step increment that persists until next quick click.

nodes.name: Market Tab Split Design
nodes.summary: Splits market page into two fixed tabs (Futures and Options) with independent contract views. Generalizes MarketTable into spec-driven QuoteTable supporting futures/options configurations. Adds exchange+product multi-select filtering, options grouping by underlying instrument, and search bar repositioning. T-Quote view preserved as secondary option within options tab.

nodes.name: Infinite Order Panel Design
nodes.summary: Designs a new Infinite Order (price ladder) tab for high-frequency point-and-click trading on a single contract. Full price ladder from limit-down to limit-up with windowed rendering (~50 visible rows), click-to-order/cancel at any price level, latest price highlight, and order badges. Reuses existing TradeParams, AccountBar, and query components. Backend zero changes.

nodes.name: Query Panel Split Design
nodes.summary: Splits existing QueryPanel (5 tabs) into three independent windows: Order Query (with status filter: all/unfilled/filled + cancel-all), Position Query (with fuzzy contract search), and residual Query Window (trades/account/stop-orders). Adds query-orders and query-positions tab types with native menu entries via existing IPC.

nodes.name: Collections (Folders) Refactor Design
nodes.summary: Refactors flat favorites into multi-folder collections system. Contracts can belong to multiple collections. Star column behavior context-dependent (market page opens picker, collection page toggles). Only active/open collection tabs trigger subscriptions (no background keep-alive). Collections page supports futures/options sub-views. Data model uses Collection with id/name/contractIDs/seriesIDs.

nodes.name: Floating Menu Reorganization Design
nodes.summary: Reorganizes native menu from market/function/settings/perf into four business-semantic groups: Market (futures/options/favorites/K-line/T-quote/new window), Trading (5-level order + infinite order), Query (order/position/account query), Settings (settings + network monitor + exit). Removes FPS monitor entirely. Tray mirrors auto via shared menu definition.

nodes.name: Query Window Dissolve and Account Window Design

nodes.name: Options Stacked T-Chain Design

nodes.name: role-a-dev-flow SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Role A (backend) dual-window collaborative development workflow skill definition. Defines a 6-step process: startup diagnosis, TDD development, self-verification, review feedback handling, manual verification, and merge finalization. Supports both development window and review window modes. Covers git branch management, commit conventions, documentation sync, flow interruption handling, and output format standards.

nodes.name: role-b-dev-flow SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Role B (frontend) dual-window collaborative development workflow skill definition. Extends Role A pattern with task source selection (task.md, task-redesign.md, or custom), lightweight documentation mode for redesign tasks, different file naming/storage rules per task source, and frontend-specific verification approaches. Defines 6-step flow: diagnosis, TDD, self-verification, review feedback, manual verification, and merge finalization.

nodes.name: simnow-bug-fix SKILL.md
nodes.summary: SimNow bug fix workflow skill. Root cause investigation is mandatory before any code changes. References task2.md for bug tracking.

nodes.name: simnow-consistency-check SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive five-dimension consistency check skill. Performs code-vs-documentation consistency, progress synchronization (git log vs task.md), front-end/back-end alignment (field names, business flows, financial domain checks), data flow consistency (end-to-end field/type/enum verification), runtime behavior analysis (timestamps, concurrency, WebSocket lifecycle), and code quality checks (dead code, type accuracy, duplication, magic values). Generates structured report with P0/P1 severity and processes items interactively with user. Does not directly modify code - writes fix plans to consistency-check-records.md.

nodes.name: simnow-resume SKILL.md

Reads knowledge graph and git history, analyzes code changes for technical highlights, generates three versions (Role A backend, Role B frontend, combined) of resume bullet points, discusses Top3 recommendations with user before writing to project-description-resume.md. Follows structured writing conventions (action + tech stack + quantified results).

nodes.name: simnow-weekly SKILL.md
nodes.summary: Weekly report generation skill for the SimNow project. Collects weekly git commits, classifies by type (feat/fix/refactor/docs/test), generates conversational-style weekly report with learning insights, work achievements, and next week plans. Emphasizes storytelling over commit listing, prohibits technical identifiers (PR numbers, filenames, function names), and uses template format for CIFFEX Suzhou branch reporting.

nodes.name: main.ts
nodes.summary: Electron main process entry point. Initializes and wires together all manager singletons (WindowManager, TrayManager, ShortcutManager, NotificationManager, BackendManager, AutoUpdaterManager, MenuManager), registers modular IPC handlers, and handles app lifecycle events (activate, window-all-closed, will-quit). Exports getter functions for each manager and the isDev flag. Auto-initializes unless running in test environment.

nodes.name: windowManager.ts
nodes.summary: Manages multiple BrowserWindow instances for the Electron application. Defines WindowConfig/WindowState interfaces and DEFAULT_CONFIGS for main (1600x1000), order (500x600), kline (1000x700), and query (800x600) windows. WindowManager class supports creating windows with hash-based routing, tracking via Map, window state save/restore, broadcasting messages, and tab detach/reattach via openTabWindow. Registers native keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+R reload, Ctrl+Shift+I devtools, Ctrl+0/+/- zoom, F11 fullscreen) via before-input-event.

nodes.name: backendManager.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the Python backend child process lifecycle. Spawns `python start.py` in the server directory, captures stdout/stderr into a ring buffer (max 1000 entries), and provides start/stop/restart/isRunning/getStatus methods. Checks if backend is already running on port 8000 before spawning. Uses SIGTERM for graceful shutdown with a 5-second SIGKILL fallback. BackendConfig defaults: command='python', args=['start.py'], cwd='../../server', port=8000.

nodes.name: preload.ts
nodes.summary: Electron preload script that exposes a safe ElectronAPI to the renderer process via contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld. Defines the ElectronAPI interface with window control (minimize/maximize/close), window management (open order/kline/tab), app info (version/platform/name), backend management (restart/status), navigation events (onNavigateTab), menu events (onOpenFloatingTab, onMarketView), data exchange (getSelectedInstrument), and event listeners (orderUpdate, notification, IPC monitor). All IPC channel strings are hardcoded to match ipc/index.ts constants.

nodes.name: autoUpdater.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps electron-updater for automatic application updates. AutoUpdaterManager tracks update status (checking/available/not-available/downloading/downloaded/error) and updateInfo. Configures autoDownload=false and autoInstallOnAppQuit=true. Shows native dialog boxes to prompt user for download and install. Sends status updates to renderer via 'update-status' channel. Includes checkForUpdates, downloadUpdate, and quitAndInstall methods.

nodes.name: trayManager.ts
nodes.summary: Manages the system tray icon and context menu. Uses shared menu definitions from menuTemplate.ts (getAppMenuDef) plus a top-level '退出' item. Builds context menu via buildMenuFromDef. Intercepts main window close event to minimize to tray instead of quitting (unless app is actually quitting via before-quit flag). Supports click-to-toggle window visibility and balloon notifications. Falls back to empty nativeImage if icon.png is missing.

nodes.name: shortcuts.ts
nodes.summary: Manages global keyboard shortcuts using Electron's globalShortcut API. ShortcutManager supports register/unregister with conflict detection, update (change accelerator for existing action), and persistence to shortcuts.json in userData. Default shortcuts: Ctrl+B (quick order), Ctrl+K (K-line), Ctrl+Q (quit). Provides load/save/loadAndRegister/resetToDefaults for lifecycle management.

nodes.name: notificationManager.ts
nodes.summary: Manages native system notifications using Electron's Notification API. Provides typed notification methods: showOrderNotification (maps CTP status codes to Chinese text), showStopOrderNotification (pending/triggered/trigger_failed/canceled), and showConnectionNotification (with silent flag for reconnections). Tracks active notifications for cleanup via closeAll().

nodes.name: menuManager.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the application menu bar from the shared menu template. Single initialize() method that calls buildMenuFromDef(getAppMenuDef(), ctx) and applies it via Menu.setApplicationMenu. Thin orchestrator delegating to menuTemplate and menuActions.

nodes.name: menuActions.ts
nodes.summary: Maps MenuAction discriminated union types (from menuTemplate.ts) to real Electron behavior. resolveAction() dispatches: market-view sends IPC to switch market view, open-floating sends IPC to open a floating tab, open-market-window calls windowManager.openTabWindow, quit calls app.quit(). Shared by both the top app menu and tray context menu. Uses showAndSend helper to focus main window before sending IPC.

nodes.name: menuTemplate.ts
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for all application menus. Defines the four-group menu structure (行情/交易/查询/设置) via getAppMenuDef() returning MenuItemDef[]. Exports buildMenuFromDef() which recursively converts MenuItemDef[] to Electron MenuItemConstructorOptions[], with optional omitIds filtering (used by tray to remove items). Defines MenuAction discriminated union type (market-view, open-floating, open-market-window, quit) and FloatingTab union type covering all floating window tabs.

nodes.name: ipcMonitor.ts
nodes.summary: Monitors IPC communications between main and renderer processes. IPCMonitor class intercepts ipcMain.handle calls by wrapping the original method to capture incoming messages. Maintains a ring buffer (max 1000) of IPCMessage objects with timestamp, direction, channel, data, and windowId. Provides listener pattern for real-time forwarding to renderer via 'ipc-monitor-messages' and 'ipc-monitor-message' channels. Singleton via getIPCMonitor().

nodes.name: ipcWrapper.ts
nodes.summary: Wraps IPC handlers to automatically log messages for the IPC Monitor. Provides handleIPC() (register + log), wrapHandler() (wrap existing handler), sendToWindow() (send + log), and broadcast() (send to all windows + log). Maintains a global message store with listener pattern. sendIPCMonitorToWindow() sends accumulated messages and sets up real-time forwarding to a renderer window.

nodes.name: ipc/index.ts
nodes.summary: Centralized IPC channel definitions and type contracts. Exports IPC_CHANNELS constant object with all channel strings (window:*, app:*, backend:*, navigate:*, menu:*, data:*, order:*, notification). Defines TypeScript interfaces for IPCResponse, WindowControlAPI, WindowManagementAPI, AppInfoAPI, BackendManagementAPI, EventListenerAPI, and the composite ElectronAPI interface. Also defines BackendStatus, OrderUpdateEvent, and NotificationEvent types.

nodes.name: ipc/app.ts
nodes.summary: Registers IPC handlers for app info (version, platform, name) and backend management (restart, status). Uses handleIPC wrapper from ipcWrapper for logging. Three exported functions: registerAppInfoHandlers, registerBackendManagementHandlers, unregisterAppHandlers. Backend status returns BackendStatus type from ipc/index.

nodes.name: ipc/window.ts
nodes.summary: Registers IPC handlers for window control (minimize, maximize/restore, close) and window management (open order window, open kline window, open tab window). Uses handleIPC wrapper from ipcWrapper. registerWindowControlHandlers takes mainWindow, registerWindowManagementHandlers takes WindowManager. Also exports unregisterWindowHandlers for cleanup.

nodes.name: build-electron.cjs
nodes.summary: Build script for packaging the Electron application. Accepts platform argument (win/mac/linux/all), validates that icon files exist in the build directory (with warnings for missing or empty files), then delegates to electron-builder via npm run electron:build with appropriate platform flags. Uses execSync for synchronous build execution.

nodes.name: compile-electron.cjs
nodes.summary: Post-compilation script that processes Electron TypeScript output. Step 1: runs `npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json`. Step 2: recursively processes dist-electron directory to fix require() and import paths by appending .cjs extension to relative paths, then renames all .js files to .cjs for CommonJS compatibility. Uses regex replacement to handle both single and double quoted paths.

nodes.name: generate-icons.cjs
nodes.summary: Generates placeholder icon files for electron-builder. Creates a minimal 1x1 transparent PNG for icon.png, and empty placeholder files for icon.ico and icon.icns. Intended for development/testing; production builds should use real icon files. Writes all files to the frontend/build/ directory.

nodes.name: repro-detach.cjs
nodes.summary: Puppeteer-based test script that reproduces tab detach behavior in the Electron app's web UI. Uses Edge browser, navigates to localhost:5173, clicks the settings gear button in the bottom bar, then simulates dragging the settings tab pill to trigger detach. Dumps tab bar state, visible panels, floating overlay children, and floating window chrome before and after detach. Takes a screenshot for visual verification.

Configures TypeScript parser, react-refresh plugin, and two custom rules: react-refresh only-export-components (warn with allowConstantExport) and @typescript-eslint/no-unused-vars (warn with argsIgnorePattern for underscore-prefixed args). Ignores dist directory.

nodes.name: account.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for trading account funds (AccountInfo) and investor positions (PositionInfo). AccountInfo tracks balance, margin, P&L, commission. PositionInfo tracks per-instrument position with direction, costs, and margin. Uses camelCase fields aligned with CTP.

nodes.name: contract.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic model for CTP instrument/contract info (InstrumentInfo). Fields include exchange, product type, volume multiple, price tick, expiry dates, margin ratios, and options-specific fields (type, strike price, underlying).

nodes.name: market.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for market data: MarketSnapshot (full depth market data with 5-level bid/ask, prices, volume, timestamps) and KLineData (single OHLCV candlestick bar with period).

nodes.name: options.py
nodes.summary: Dataclass models for options data: OptionQuote (single option quote with strike, type, bid/ask/volume/OI), OptionChain (grouped by underlying+expiry with calls/puts), and VolatilityData (Black-Scholes implied volatility parameters). Includes to_dict/from_dict serialization.

nodes.name: order.py
nodes.summary: Pydantic models for order operations: OrderRequest (submit order input with direction, offset, price type, volume, time/volume conditions) and OrderReturn (CTP order status return with fill info, timestamps, session identity).

nodes.name: ctp_bridge.py
nodes.summary: CTP callback bridge connecting MdSpi callbacks to the async web layer. wire_market_data_callback() registers OnRtnDepthMarketData handler that: maps CTP PascalCase fields via field_mapping, updates MarketService snapshot cache, broadcasts via WebSocket, updates KLineService bars, and checks stop order triggers. Central glue between CTP worker thread and services.

nodes.name: ctp_startup.py
nodes.summary: CTP connection management with two entry points: start_ctp_market_connection() for app startup (auto-connect MD) and connect_ctp() for explicit login with credentials. Wires CTP SPI callbacks (instrument query, order/trade/position/account query) to service layer. Manages CTP thread lifecycle with threading.Event for login timeout. 1129 lines — the largest service file.

nodes.name: field_mapping.py
nodes.summary: CTP PascalCase-to-camelCase field mapping layer. Contains mapping tables and functions for: depth market data (map_depth_market_data), input orders (map_input_order), order returns (map_order), trade returns (map_trade), positions (map_position), account info (map_account). Sanitizes CTP DBL_MAX sentinel values. 50+ field mappings. Used by bridge and query services.

nodes.name: kline_service.py
nodes.summary: Real-time K-line aggregation service. Accumulates CTP tick data into multi-period OHLCV bars (1m/5m/15m/30m/1h). Handles CTP timestamp parsing (ActionDay+UpdateTime in UTC+8), cross-midnight edge cases, cumulative-to-delta volume conversion. Thread-safe via lock. No historical data — bars accumulate only from server start.

nodes.name: market_service.py
nodes.summary: Core market data service managing: instrument cache (loaded from CTP query or JSON file, filters expired contracts), market data snapshot cache (thread-safe via lock), and subscription tracking (500-contract limit). Provides set_ctp_hooks() for CTP subscribe/unsubscribe injection. Used by API routes and ctp_bridge.

nodes.name: options_service.py
nodes.summary: Options data service providing: option contract filtering (productClass='2'), option chain aggregation (grouped by underlying+expiry with calls/puts), and implied volatility calculation using Black-Scholes model. Stateless — operates on instrument lists passed in.

nodes.name: order_manager.py
nodes.summary: Unified order operations hub wrapping TraderApi. Provides: pending-order creation before CTP response, callback-driven state updates (OnRtnOrder, OnRtnTrade), cancel_all with active order knowledge, reverse/lock operations. Thread-safe via RLock. Session identity filtering prevents stale callbacks. 547 lines.

nodes.name: query_service.py
nodes.summary: CTP query orchestration and result caching. Handles the CTP callback accumulation pattern (multiple OnRspQryXxx with bIsLast flag). Provides thread-safe query methods for orders, trades, positions, and account info. Uses threading.Event for sync between CTP callback thread and asyncio thread pool. 10s timeout prevents indefinite blocking.

nodes.name: reconnect.py
nodes.summary: CTP reconnection service with exponential backoff. Tracks retry count, provides delay calculation (base_delay * 2^attempt), manages subscription state for auto-resubscribe after reconnect. Injected with connect_fn and subscribe_fn callables for testability.

nodes.name: stop_order.py
nodes.summary: Stop order lifecycle management with trigger monitoring. StopOrderService manages: submit/cancel/list stop orders, market data monitoring for trigger conditions, automatic order execution via OrderManager. Uses a dedicated daemon worker thread for trigger execution to avoid blocking CTP callback thread. Persists orders to data/stop_orders.json. 418 lines.

nodes.name: start.py
nodes.summary: Smart startup script that auto-selects CTP address based on trading time (PRIMARY=standard simulation during trading hours, SECONDARY=7x24 for off-hours). Loads .env, parses CLI args (--reload, --port, --host), and launches uvicorn. Contains time-based logic for commodity futures trading sessions (day + night).

tour.title: Architecture & Design
tour.description: Review the core architecture documents: design.md covers the full system architecture, dev.md details code structure, and CTP API structure defines the protocol bindings.

tour.title: Backend Services
tour.description: The Python FastAPI backend: CTP startup manages connections, market_service provides instrument data, order_manager handles trading, and ctp_bridge glues callbacks to services.

tour.title: Frontend Entry & Config
tour.description: The React frontend boots from main.tsx, with Vite handling builds and dev server. Package.json defines dependencies including vtable, ECharts, and Zustand.

tour.title: State Management
tour.description: Zustand stores manage all application state: market data, order operations, query results, tab management, collections/favorites, and user preferences.

tour.title: Market Module
tour.description: The market module handles real-time quotes, K-line charts with technical indicators (MA, BOLL, MACD, KDJ, RSI), quote tables via vtable, and subscription management.

tour.title: Order Module
tour.description: Order entry with limit/market/stop order forms, trade parameter configuration, market depth display, and account bar showing positions and balance.

tour.title: Options Module
tour.description: Options trading with T-type chain view, option chain grouping, filtering by exchange/product/underlying, and volatility calculations.

tour.title: Electron Desktop App
tour.description: Electron wraps the web app with multi-window management, system tray, global shortcuts, auto-updates, and backend process management.

tour.title: Trading Compliance
tour.description: Trading instruction compliance: volume limits, protection price validation for market orders, and exchange-specific rules aligned with Shanghai Futures Exchange.
